subject.title: fix: prevent cumulative usage from inflating session context

question: Should OpenClaw accept the fail-closed policy that shows session context as unknown when a provider lacks an exact current-call snapshot, rather than retaining the unsafe aggregate-usage estimate?
rationale: This is an intentional persisted-session and compaction-policy choice that code review can show is safer, but cannot make on behalf of the feature owners.

options.title: Approve exact-snapshot semantics
options.body: Merge after exact-head refresh if maintainers agree that unknown context is preferable to a misleading aggregate estimate.

options.title: Require an alternate compatibility policy
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers want an explicit supported estimate for providers without exact snapshots, rather than restoring the aggregate fallback implicitly.

recommendation.title: Approve exact-snapshot semantics
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head refresh if maintainers agree that unknown context is preferable to a misleading aggregate estimate.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged cached-usage work established the context-accounting invariant extended by this PR.
